work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Independent act XX has synopsis 17254–17256 and protocol 17258–17259, between the preceding dating at 17242–17246 and next XXI at 17434. Retains the historical cross-reference at 17286–17289, the complete five sections including qualifications attached to the grant, and original dating 17427–17429 together with editorial dating 17431. No foreign heading or apparatus occurs in the retained range. Substantive-extent re-audit: The present extension of the number of masters is printed at 17346–17360 with its qualifications and remaining clauses. The reference to Innocent XI supplies an incorporated condition rather than an editorial omission.
